name: Cerebras Inference API pricing - NEGATIVE: tier structure published, per-model token rates not in extracted page
region: Cerebras cloud (US); no regional GPU SKU to price
price_basis: NO price_usd recorded, deliberately. Cerebras publishes a two-tier STRUCTURE on the page - 'Cerebras Inference Tier Pricing' and 'Developer Tier Pricing' - plus a one-time $5 promotional credit for adding a payment method (expires 30 days after activation; API and Playground access pause when it expires or is exhausted unless PayGo credits are purchased separately; credit is non-transferable, no cash value, may be withheld). But the per-model per-1M-token numbers did not appear in the static HTML extraction on 2026-10-04, and no Cerebras GPU hourly rate is published. Writing down a remembered Cerebras per-token rate would be exactly the fabricated-price failure this repo's contract forbids.
notes: An honest negative that still carries two usable facts. (1) The promotional-credit mechanic is a TRAP for benchmarking: $5 of free credit means the first few thousand requests run at an effective $0 rate, so a benchmark or cost projection run immediately after signup measures nothing about the real price. Price experiments only after the credit is exhausted, or on a paid tier. (2) Cerebras sells inference on its own WSE hardware at a scale where per-GPU-hour is not a purchasable unit - there is no hourly GPU price to compare a serverless rate against, which is precisely why the per-token rate there cannot be sanity-checked the way Fireworks' can. Cerebras is also listed as a routable provider on OpenRouter and Vercel AI Gateway, both of which add their own layer and their own markup.
